[[Rotom Phone]]; ×2) * {{p|Galvantula}} ([[Nito]]'s) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Drone Rotom]]) * {{p|Larvesta}} (×2) * {{p|Larvesta}} (evolves; {{Shiny}}) * {{p|Volcarona}} (newly evolved; {{Shiny}}) ==Differences between the animated series and the manga== * [[Nito]] is driven off by [[Goh's Cinderace]] and {{TP|Goh|Inteleon}} instead of {{Ash}}, as he's not with Goh in the manga. * Goh's {{p|Krabby}} and attempt to fight the fire are omitted. * Nito's henchmen do not appear, and he's defeated by [[Danika]] before Goh exits the mine, as opposed to after it. * [[Volkner]] is never shown telling Ash about {{an|Cynthia}} being in the Master Class.
